name: check_no_pii_binaries_20261105
comment: ANCHOR: FQ-154 — a file the PII scanner cannot read is never clean.
scripts/check_no_pii.py:_decode returned None for any file with a NUL byte in its first 8 KiB, and every
caller treated None as 'nothing found', so every PNG, JPEG, PDF and archive was reported clean without being
read (two live-page captures reached a public branch through it). The suite pins the replacement contract: an
unreadable file is a binary_unreadable finding unless it is registered in config/pii_binary_review.json with a
reason, reviewer and date; the count is not ratcheted so no baseline can swallow it; --tree fails on the
existing tree; and the register must be its canonical rendering.
